p5:main.conclusion: DM half symmetry: source bridge RSS ->RSS/2, drain bridge RDD->RDD/2. i=gm(vid/2-vs),vs=iRSS/2,vo=-iRDD/2. differential ratio A=-gm RDD/(2+gm RSS)=-RDD/(RSS+2/gm). Equal gm/ideal current source/lambda0. RSS0 yields -gm RDD/2. RDD0 yields0. Reference and fragment agree.

p10:main.conclusion: Each collector DC KCL: VX=VCC-RC1 IC1, VY=VCC-RC2 IC2. VCMout=(VX+VY)/2=VCC-(RC1IC1+RC2IC2)/2. Equal RC and equal quiescent IC ->VCMout=VCC-RCIC. Small opposite increments +/-deltaI yield common output variation=(RC2-RC1)deltaI/2; equal resistors cancel to first order. Nonlinear expo currents do not keep sum constant for finite differential amplitude: equal resistors gives VCC-RC IC0 cosh(v/VT), showing only local first-order cancellation. Reference and fragment agree.
